input: Same synthetic RGBA16F color /RG16F zero-motion, full8 blocks,1 pass; external model DLL310.8.0.0. GPU interval excludes uploads/readbacks.
automatic_method: Actual production auto-selection; ABBA fresh processes;256 frames discard128 for standard sizes,128 discard32 at odd threshold boundaries. GPU whole-frame intervals; no per-launch timing.

resolution_policy.scope: Empirical RTX5080 policy; no optimality claim for unmeasured shapes/devices.

screening_method: 96 full-network frames, discard32, one changed kernel. Per-launch timing screening at8K; baseline brackets every4 candidates. Neither whole intervals nor summed family medians from instrumented screening are shipping speed claims.

whole_combination_trial.method: 256 full-network frames, discard128. Stock clocks observed, no per-launch timing. Balanced original/memory/candidate/NVIDIA/NVIDIA/candidate/memory/original process order at each extent. GPU interval excludes uploads/readbacks. Means of process medians.

threshold_trial.method: 256 frames, discard128; original/candidate/candidate/original fresh process order, no per-launch timing. 4K checks memory-only;6K checks combined selection.

validation.scope: Candidate reset/final hashes match original Phoenix; matched NVIDIA trial checks final hashes. Not every frame was read back; not moving-scene certification.

limitations: Stock GPU clocks observed, not locked.
Per-launch queries are diagnostic; use whole-frame trials for speed claims.
No hardware cache-miss, bandwidth, instruction throughput or dynamic spill-traffic counters available.
Owned model/frame allocations unchanged; driver/code residency is outside that allocation ledger.
